acceptance: The shadow jobs run the selector and impacted-test shards in the workflow chosen by D1 (trunk.yml diffing github.event.before..github.sha, or ci.yml on pull_request), with job-level continue-on-error and outside any required unit.
release_canary_sharding.py supports --allow-empty with unit tests; the default still rejects empty input.

Workflow tests cover empty, non-empty, whole-suite fallback, and selector-failure results, and assert the jobs cannot redden trunk or block release admission (trunk) or are not in .github/ci-units.yml requirements (pull_request).
The first live run shows the selector summary and, if tests were selected, their shard results; its date is recorded in this item.
context:
Guardrails:
1. Shadow means non-blocking: give the jobs job-level continue-on-error: true so they cannot redden trunk, block release admission, or trigger the pr-open red-trunk refusal. A workflow test asserts this.
2. Placement follows D1. For pull_request placement, target .github/workflows/ci.yml and keep the new jobs out of the unit requirements in .github/ci-units.yml, so they are not part of any required check. Gating is a separate decision (see canary-impact-06-required-gate) and is out of scope here.
3. Selector failure or missing output falls back to running the whole canary suite in the shadow job, and records why. Never silently skip.
4. Keep the release canary unchanged; it remains the full daily backstop.
5. The workflow file is a soundness path: maintainer review required, no auto-merge.
6. Workflow tests cover: empty selection, non-empty selection, whole-suite fallback, and selector failure; and that the jobs have job-level continue-on-error and are not required.
7. Record the date of the first trunk run (or PR head run) that executes the shadow job in this item when it happens; canary-impact-05-shadow-watch measures its 14 days from that date.

description:
Start only after D1 in canary-impact-03-replay-and-go-decision is recorded as go. D1 also records the placement. The text below is for the trunk placement; if D1 chose pull_request placement, apply the same jobs to .github/workflows/ci.yml instead (see guardrail 2).

Add to .github/workflows/trunk.yml (runs on each push to develop):
- a canary-impact selector job that runs scripts/canary_impact.py against the diff github.event.before..github.sha and publishes its JSON result as an artifact and in the step summary;
- a canary-impacted test job, sharded with scripts/release_canary_sharding.py (new --allow-empty mode), sized from the selector's shard count, running the selected node IDs with the canary marker expression.

Zero-selection contract: when nothing is selected, the selector job succeeds, records "0 selected" and the reason in the step summary, and the test shards are skipped. The sharder with --allow-empty writes an empty shard instead of raising.

In this item the jobs are a shadow: they run and report on every trunk run but cannot redden trunk.
